nina_support: Heads up — support case: async sample in samples/async_echo.py fails on Windows 3.9/3.11 venvs behind corp HTTP proxy. Error: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError -> httpx.ConnectError (Max retries). Anyone seen this?

nina_support: repro steps: python -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\activate; pip install -r samples/requirements.txt; set HTTPS_PROXY=...; python samples\async_echo.py

leo_py: sounds like the classic Windows venv + corporate MITM cert issue. Do you see REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE or SSL_CERT_FILE set? Which OpenSSL does python use (python -c "import ssl;print(ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION)")?

nina_support: env vars not set. Python Windows installer 3.11.4 and one customer on 3.9.12. Works fine on mac/linux. Stack (trimmed):
```
ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] unable to get local issuer certificate
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
httpx.ConnectError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.redwood.ai', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /v1/generate
```

sam_sdk: two related problems: (A) venv/OpenSSL on Windows not using system CA, (B) our retry layer hides the original SSLError. Quick support workaround: pip install certifi certifi-win32 and set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where() or use certifi-win32 to bridge winstore to certifi.

maria_sec: note: certifi-win32 may be disallowed by some customers' policies. Document both options and call out policy tradeoffs.

leo_py: SDK action items: 1) add ca_bundle / verify parameter to AsyncClient and sync client (mirror requests), 2) honor SSL_CERT_FILE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE envs early, 3) expose httpx options like trust_env, 4) improve error message when cert verification fails to include a short troubleshooting hint.

sam_sdk: implementation sketch: cafile = os.environ.get('SSL_CERT_FILE') or os.environ.get('REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE') or certifi.where(); ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=cafile); pass to httpx transport. Also raise CertVerificationError chaining the original SSLError instead of surfacing as generic Max retries.

leo_py: typing compatibility note: we've had import errors on py3.8 where we used typing.ParamSpec/Protocol without typing_extensions. Plan: add typing_extensions as conditional dependency for py<3.10 or include in extras.

maria_sec: for Private deployments, add a short checklist: how to mount CA bundles, proxy/KMS allowlist, and firewall rules (OCSP/CRL). Also include openssl s_client example to validate chains.

sam_sdk: I'll open a PR to: add ca_bundle kwarg, respect env vars, let users pass httpx_client_options, add CertVerificationError with hint text, and pin typing_extensions conditionally. Will add unit tests mocking certifi.where.

deploy-bot: created branch fix/win-ca-venv (sha: def456) and opened PR draft #987.

nina_support: great — for immediate triage I'll advise affected customers to try running samples in WSL or set SSL_CERT_FILE or install certifi-win32 if policy allows. I'll attach guidance to the KB article. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
